import html # Example template – in practice this could be loaded from a file or defined elsewhere. html_template = """ Generated Page

User Content

{user_content}
""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generate an HTML page by safely embedding user-provided content. Parameters ---------- user_content : str Raw text supplied by the user that should be displayed on the page. Returns ------- str The full HTML document with `user_content` safely escaped. Notes ----- - Uses ``html.escape`` to prevent XSS attacks by converting special characters (e.g., <, >, &, ", ') into their corresponding HTML entities. - No exceptions are raised by this function; any errors would arise from the underlying ``html.escape`` implementation.
